description: Tasks template for modernization plan. Generate this file alongside plan.md to track individual migration tasks.

tasks.description: Upgrade the application from Java 8 / Spring Boot 2.7.18 to Java 25 / Spring Boot 4.x to meet internal LTS policy requirements.
tasks.reason: Java 8 is end-of-life for internal use and Spring Boot 2.x must be upgraded per the Acme Corp Modernization Playbook charter. Spring Boot 4.x upgrade includes Java 25 and Spring Framework 7.x.
tasks.requirements: Upgrade Spring Boot from 2.7.18 to 4.x and Java from 8 to 25. The upgrade must include all framework-level changes (Spring Framework 7.x, Jakarta EE namespace migration from javax.* to jakarta.*). All existing functionality must continue to work after the upgrade.

tasks.description: Migrate messaging from RabbitMQ AMQP to Azure Service Bus with Managed Identity authentication.
tasks.reason: The application uses RabbitMQ AMQP for message processing across three queues (order-created, inventory-alert, approval-pending). Migrating to Azure Service Bus replaces the on-premises message broker with a managed Azure service using secure passwordless authentication.
tasks.requirements: Migrate all three RabbitMQ queues (order-created, inventory-alert, approval-pending) to Azure Service Bus. Replace Spring AMQP RabbitMQ dependencies with Azure Service Bus equivalents. Update all message consumer listeners to use Azure Service Bus. Use Managed Identity for authentication (no connection string passwords). Remove all RabbitMQ-specific configuration.

tasks.description: Migrate hardcoded credentials from application configuration to Azure Key Vault.
tasks.reason: The application.yml contains hardcoded RabbitMQ credentials (username, password, host). Storing sensitive values in source-controlled configuration files is a security violation. Azure Key Vault with Managed Identity provides secure, centralized secrets management as required by policy.
tasks.requirements: Identify and migrate all hardcoded credentials, passwords, and connection secrets from application.yml and source code to Azure Key Vault. Access secrets via Managed Identity. Ensure no plaintext credentials remain in configuration files or source code.

tasks.description: Replace all SLF4J logging and System.out.println usages with InternalLogger.
tasks.reason: Policy prohibits SLF4J (@Slf4j, LoggerFactory), Log4j, Logback, java.util.logging, and System.out.println because they lack trace context integration. InternalLogger (com.acme.logging.InternalLogger) is the sole approved logging framework as it injects trace IDs, team tags, and structured JSON.
tasks.requirements: Replace all @Slf4j annotations, LoggerFactory.getLogger() calls, and System.out.println/System.err.println usages with InternalLogger (com.acme.logging.InternalLogger). Remove SLF4J and Logback dependencies. InternalLogger must be the sole logging mechanism in the application.

tasks.description: Replace exception-based flow control with the Result<T> pattern.
tasks.reason: Post-incident mandate P0-2024-0847 prohibits throwing exceptions for business logic flow control and try/catch blocks used for flow control. The Result<T> pattern (com.acme.commons.Result) is the approved alternative for all error handling in application code.
tasks.requirements: Replace all try/catch blocks used for business logic flow control with the Result<T> pattern (com.acme.commons.Result). Ensure no exceptions are thrown for business logic flow control. All business logic error paths must return Result<T> values instead of using exception handling.

tasks.description: Containerize the SupplyChain Worker application for deployment to Azure Container Apps.
tasks.reason: Azure Container Apps is the default compute platform for all Java services in the supply chain system per the Acme Corp Modernization Playbook. Containerization is required before deployment.
tasks.requirements: Create a multi-stage Dockerfile using mcr.microsoft.com/openjdk/jdk:25-ubuntu as the build stage image and mcr.microsoft.com/openjdk/jdk:25-distroless as the runtime stage image. The container must expose the application on port 8082.

tasks.description: Deploy the containerized SupplyChain Worker to Azure Container Apps.
tasks.reason: Azure Container Apps is the default compute platform for Java services in the supply chain system per the charter. Managed Identity is required for all service-to-service authentication per policy.
tasks.requirements: Deploy the containerized application to Azure Container Apps. Configure Managed Identity for service authentication. Provision required Azure resources (Azure Container Apps environment, Azure Service Bus namespace, Azure Key Vault). Use Bicep for infrastructure as code.
